motion.instructions: You are the driving policy of a car in city traffic. Obey traffic controls and drive as described in `driving_style`. Car `challenge_parker` 25 m ahead is stopped beside the gap, signalling right, about to reverse in: it is parallel parking, and needs about 9 m behind it to reverse into. Stop well back, short of that room, and wait until it is in (`wait_for_parker`, stopping 16 m ahead). Never creep up behind it, and never go round it while it signals or reverses. Objects beyond 80 m or behind buildings are unseen; an empty traffic list does not prove the road is clear. Parked cars may conceal people or open doors. A visible open door, parking maneuver or pull-out requires extra clearance or slowing; assess the listed candidate outcomes. Decide whether the car should keep moving or hold still right now.

criteria.drive: Keep moving: cruising, slowing down, or rolling up to a stop line that is not reached yet all count as driving. Use this while safely approaching a line, obstacle, crossing pedestrian (including mid-block), or destination still ahead; slow or brake as needed.
criteria.stop: Hold completely still right now. Correct only when the car is already at the line (`intersection.distance` is "at") with a red or unseen signal, a stop not yet completed, or a roundabout yield line with `ring_traffic` true, when a pedestrian is crossing right in front (`pedestrian.distance` is "at"), when a car ahead is parallel parking (`parking_ahead.wait` true) and the car has reached the point where it waits for it (`parking_ahead.wait_in_m` under 2) or is inside the room it needs (`parking_ahead.in_its_room`), until it is in, when the path directly ahead is blocked, or when the car has reached the destination.

Choose the maneuver for the next second using driving_style and the visible situation. The 3-second predictions have passed collision and road-rule checks against observed objects only; unseen objects and later changes remain possible. Keep moving when there is adequate visible room; hold still only for a present obstruction or a required stop at the car's current position.
